source_rank.usage: Visible row order on the successfully parsed FFToday kicker projection page.

Rank.usage: Deterministic K-only projection ranking and list-length-aware percentile input.
Rank.normalization: projected_fantasy_points descending, FGM descending, EPM descending, source_player_id

projection_adp_gap.definition: FFToday Kicker projection percentile minus FFC Kicker ADP percentile on a scale where higher is better.
projection_adp_gap.positive_interpretation: Projected production is relatively stronger than observed mock-draft cost.

league_adjustments: Keep FGM, FGA, FG%, EPM and EPA as source projections independent of the provider fantasy-point formula.
Do not treat source FPts as the Mighty Giants league scoring result unless the scoring formulas are explicitly reconciled.
Apply the six-team replacement level and one fixed kicker starter during analysis.
Use current kicker job and competition evidence separately from the projection ranking.
limitations: FFToday does not expose a documented public Projection API in the audited surface.
The HTML parser depends on the public table and official player-link structure.
Custom-scoring views require a logged-in league profile and are intentionally not used.
Projection values are provider estimates and can change materially during training camp and the season.
